answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a ferrous-strong bond before trading: the bond is collateral, not a fee, and it is slashed if peers attest fraud. New identities start hollow, with zero reputation, and must earn trust through small verified jobs before larger ones unlock, so spawning thousands of sock puppets gains nothing — each fake would have to wander the same slow, costly earning path, and the stake makes every fake identity expensive to keep.
